name: tinyactors-website-example-journal
description: The journal guide's program: an order whose inputs are journaled, replayed on a SimulatedClock with processors that do nothing, and restored on the runtime's clock. browser.mjs is the same program in a browser, on @tinyactors/wasm; main.py is the same program in Python; it joins the test (a pyproject.toml beside it) once the tinyactors package on PyPI has host.now(). mise run test runs main.mjs and browser.mjs and compares what it prints with output.txt.
